description: CLI that deploys a correctly hardened VLESS+Reality VPN (Remnawave panel, XHTTP, Hysteria2, relays) on your own servers and hands each person a connection page and QR code.
rules: Install with `uv tool install meridian-vpn` (or `curl -sSf https://getmeridian.org/install.sh | bash`); the PyPI package is meridian-vpn and the command is `meridian`.
Start with `meridian setup` for a guided fleet of one or more servers, or `meridian deploy IP` for one server; both end with each person's connection page and subscription URL.
Change a fleet only through Meridian commands (`setup`, `client|node|relay add/remove`, `plan`, `apply`); never edit `cluster.yml` by hand or change Meridian-managed objects in the Remnawave panel.
Run `meridian plan` before `meridian apply --yes`; plan exits 0 when converged and 2 when changes are pending.
Commands that accept `--json` print a `meridian.output/v1` envelope; read results under `data`. Exit codes: 2 user error, 3 evidence unavailable, 4 a check found problems, 5 cancelled.
`meridian check` inspects servers over SSH; `meridian test` sends real traffic from the current machine, and `meridian test --probe` shows what a censor sees.
Connection pages and subscription URLs grant access: treat them as secrets. The admin password is printed only by `meridian panel --show-password`.
Never use apple.com or www.microsoft.com as the Reality camouflage target (`--sni`); prefer what `meridian scan` finds in the server's own network.
`meridian help agents` prints the full guide for AI agents operating Meridian.
